notes.title: Monthly update: Development News !! Mocap is coming
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !!! 

Thank you guys for you continuous support and feedback. We have been a little quiet from the last month and we wanted to apologize for that, but there is a big reason why we have not been so active:

We have received our mocap system at stamina-games studio and we are re-doing all animations and adding new ones with a much better quality than previous ones.

Big changes are coming and more content will be added soon. Thank you for your patience and as well for your continuous feedback. We will keep working hard to make a much better game. So please keep playing and testing the game to provide us with your valuable feedback.

notes.title: Monthly update: Controller suport and Tournament modes added
notes.notes:
Hello everyone !!!

Thank you guys for you continuous support and feedback. We are continuing workings hard to make a better game  and now we are bringing in our 0.5a Version the new advanced Controller support, Survival, Single and Co-op tournaments modes.

Along with this update we have added a moves menu where you will be able to see the various moves you can perform inside soccer rage.

Also we wanted to thank you as well for your continuous feedback and let you know that we are working hard to bring more features and updates. So please keep playing and testing the game to provide us with your valuable feedback. 

** Problems with Windows10 have been solved along other minor bugs related to performance.

And do not forget to review Soccer Rage >>  store.steampowered.com/app/356510
